svg.text: The factory grows into stages that feed each other, each run by a foreman robot who writes its crew’s instructions.
You still give robots instructions and watch what they do with them. You just talk to foremen, and your words travel further.
one line, you talk to every robot
you talk to foremen (crowned), same floor view
Line A paints everything blue. Blue boxes pile up between A and B,
and Line B can’t build mixed crates without red. One misread travels down the chain.
You can walk to any line, open any robot, or talk to anyone.
Line B needs red too. Paint
Same loop as Line lead: say it, watch,
see what they made of it, fix it.
Between shifts (about a minute, not the game)
Corporate’s order sets the plant’s output; each line’s target follows from the chain.
Split the budget across lines, move robots between lines, pick foremen. Repairs stay each line’s business.
Symmetry: what the boss does to you, you do to your foremen
Mike’s principle, where it makes sense. The boss never gives you robot-style rules: you have a brain.
You to a foreman: you → each foreman (from the plant’s order)
You to a foreman: you → each line (your split)
Boss to you: moves your robots, sends new ones
You to a foreman: you move robots between lines
Boss to you: the boss’s briefing card
You to a foreman: your briefing to each foreman
Standing rules for how to work
Boss to you: no, you have a brain
You to a foreman: a foreman’s standing instructions
